name: Diary page logs an activity entry and shows it in the entries list
description: A logged-in user navigates to the daily log, selects a Transportation/Car/Petrol activity with a quantity of 20, submits the form, and the new entry appears in the entries list.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /auth/login and sign in with email 'demo@offset.io' and password 'Password123!'
Verify the 'Daily log' page heading and the 'Log something you did' form panel are visible
Select 'TRANSPORTATION' in the 'What kind of activity?' category dropdown
Click the 'Log activity' button to submit the form
Verify a success notice 'Activity logged' appears, or the entries list in the right panel now contains a new entry row showing a CO₂e value
